meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后，机器人就能接入 DeltaChat：用户可在 DeltaChat 应用里通过邀请链接或二维码加它为联系人，之后通过邮件收发消息，全程加密，还支持附件、换头像。
howto.when: 当用户要求为机器人添加 DeltaChat 邮箱聊天通道，或提到配置 DeltaChat 账号、生成邀请链接时触发。

say.text: 给机器人接入 DeltaChat 邮箱通道。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤安装并配置。

say.text: 设置 DeltaChat 的 IMAP 和 SMTP 凭据。
say.note: 引导补齐 DC_* 环境变量。

say.text: 获取 DeltaChat 邀请链接和二维码。
say.note: 从日志和 SVG 文件读取。

howto.what_en: After installation, the bot can be reached in DeltaChat: users add it via an invite link or QR code, then exchange email-based messages with end-to-end encryption. Attachments and avatar changes are supported.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a DeltaChat email chat channel to the bot, or mentions configuring DeltaChat credentials or generating an invite link.

say_en.text: Add a DeltaChat email channel to the bot.
say_en.note: Claude will install and configure it.

say_en.text: Set up the DeltaChat IMAP and SMTP credentials.
say_en.note: Guides filling the DC_* env vars.

say_en.text: Get the DeltaChat invite link and QR code.
say_en.note: Reads from logs and the SVG file.
